name: services
title: Services
description: A heading and a grid of service cards: an icon, a name, two lines about it, a proof point and a link.

variants.default: Heading on the left, link at the end of the row

title.label: Heading
title.help: *Words in stars* are set in italics.

lede.label: Line under the heading
lede.help: One line of introduction, if the section needs it.

link_label.label: Link
link_label.help: A link at the end of the heading row, like "All services".

rule.label: Rule under the heading
rule.help: A heavy line between the heading row and the grid.

columns.label: Columns
columns.help: The most in a row; fewer fit on a narrow screen. One makes a single column.

number.label: Number label
number.help: A small label above the name, like "01 — Laravel".

subtitle.label: Second line of the name
subtitle.help: Shown under the name, as part of the heading. *Stars* for italics.

text.label: About it
text.help: Two lines on what's included and who it's for.

proof.label: Proof point
proof.help: A result or guarantee, shown as a chip.
